# Command cookbook

Practical recipes for common DXSpider tasks.

## I only want HF CW spots

```text
ACCEPT/SPOTS 1 ON HF/CW
```

Undo it:

```text
CLEAR/SPOTS ALL
```

## I want RBN CW spots, but not every digital mode

```text
SET/WANTRBN CW
ACCEPT/RBN 1 ON HF/CW
```

## I want FT8/FT4 human comments but not obviously autogenerated reports

```text
ENABLE/FTX
DISABLE/AUTOFTX
```

This keeps FT4/FT8 spots enabled while suppressing comments recognised as machine-generated by the current DXSpider logic.

## I want to see my current cluster context

```text
SHOW/CONFIGURATION
SHOW/CLUSTER
SHOW/VERSION
WHO
```

## I want to contact another user

```text
TALK G1ABC Hello John
```

For an interactive conversation:

```text
TALK G1ABC
```

Inside talk mode, prefix DXSpider commands with `/`.

## I want a startup command sequence

```text
SET/STARTUP
```

Enter the commands you want executed when you connect. Inspect it with:

```text
SHOW/STARTUP
```

and remove it with:

```text
UNSET/STARTUP
```
